performance_policy_evidence.evidence_basis: public GitHub HTTPS API: immutable, published_at and asset digest

policy.adjustment_limitations: economic-return approximation; ignores cash/share delivery delays and dividend reinvestment costs; not an executable cash/share ledger; reference rounding may differ from exact distributions
policy.adjustment_method: vendor adjusted prices, with identified subscription-only adjustment removed; same-day close factor may reconstruct missing adjusted open
policy.benchmark_nav: gross total return close-to-close, same measurement dates; no trading costs
policy.benchmark_open: TAIEX TR open derived from official price-index open times same-day TR-close/price-close ratio; rounded-input approximation, post-close evaluation only
policy.cash_reuse: same_open_sale_proceeds_reusable; settlement financing and queue capacity not modelled
policy.cohort_return: equal weight adjusted open entry to adjusted open tenth session after entry
policy.corporate_actions: adjusted open execution and adjusted close valuation; no separate dividend cash, bonus shares or payment/delivery waiting
policy.cost_interpretation: Assumptions, not calibrated execution costs or worst-case bounds
policy.failed_buy: cash to next session pool and next session list; no stale buy order
policy.failed_sell: retain exposure and retry next session; proceeds buy that session list
policy.limits: buy blocked at upper limit; sell blocked at lower limit; no future intraday high/low used
policy.public_gate: verified disclosed membership only; NAV stops at first undisclosed or invalid session
policy.quantity: initial buy rounded down to raw whole shares; hold adjusted economic units; sell raw-equivalent fractional quantity
policy.rounding: buy price up and sell price down to valid tick; whole-share quantity down

scenarios.label: 偏保守模擬：0.30%／至少 1 檔

policy.statistics_start: close of tenth planned session; never wait for favourable actual full investment
